entries.title: CareBridge data environment and download restrictions
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd is restricted to accessing only De-identified Data within the CareBridge Clinics secure environment, and is prohibited from downloading or transferring such data to its own systems or devices.
entries.quote: Subcontractor shall access De-identified Data only within the Covered Entity Environment (as defined in the Upstream BAA) or another secure environment approved in writing by Business Associate and the Covered Entity. Subcontractor shall not download, copy or transfer De-identified Data to its own systems or devices.

relatedClauses.quote: "Engagement" means the CareBridge Engagement described in Schedule 1.
The patient-scheduling analytics services under SOW-1 of the above Master Services Agreement, including model development and dashboard build using De-identified Data

entries.endRule: Earlier of Upstream BAA expiration/termination or end of Engagement Services
entries.notes: The term of this agreement is tied to the expiration of the Upstream BAA or the end of the Engagement Services, neither of which is specifically dated in this agreement.

entries.title: CareBridge incident and PHI reporting windows
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd must report security incidents, uses/disclosures not provided for, or breaches within 2 business days to AtliQ Inc, and must notify AtliQ Inc within 1 business day if it discovers any data containing PHI.
entries.quote: Subcontractor shall report to Business Associate any use or disclosure not provided for by this Agreement, any Security Incident and any actual or suspected Breach within two (2) business days after discovery

relatedClauses.quote: If Subcontractor becomes aware that any data made available to it contains PHI, Subcontractor shall immediately cease access and notify Business Associate within one (1) business day

entries.endRule: Earlier of Upstream BAA expiration/termination or end of Engagement Services
entries.notes: The term of this agreement is tied to the expiration of the Upstream BAA or the end of the Engagement Services, neither of which is specifically dated in this agreement.

entries.title: CareBridge subcontractor prohibition
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd is prohibited from engaging any further subcontractor for the CareBridge Engagement Services.
entries.quote: Subcontractor shall not engage any further subcontractor for the Engagement Services.

relatedClauses.quote: "Engagement Services" means the services performed by Subcontractor for Business Associate under the Intercompany Agreement in connection with the Engagement.

entries.endRule: Earlier of Upstream BAA expiration/termination or end of Engagement Services
entries.notes: The term of this agreement is tied to the expiration of the Upstream BAA or the end of the Engagement Services, neither of which is specifically dated in this agreement.

entries.title: CareBridge HIPAA records audit rights
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd must make its internal practices, books, and records relating to the CareBridge engagement services available to AtliQ Inc and the US Secretary of HHS for compliance determination.
entries.quote: Subcontractor shall make its internal practices, books and records relating to the Engagement Services available to Business Associate and to the Secretary for purposes of determining compliance with HIPAA.
entries.endRule: Earlier of Upstream BAA expiration/termination or end of Engagement Services
entries.notes: The term of this agreement is tied to the expiration of the Upstream BAA or the end of the Engagement Services, neither of which is specifically dated in this agreement.
